day_shape: UNSC fails to renew Iran sanctions Panel of Experts mandate with UK regretting the veto, IRGC claims strike on Togo-flagged tanker in Hormuz, State Dept unveils Operation Economic Outcast crypto sanctions, and ISIS satellite imagery shows Parchin Taleghan 2 rebuild.

threads.label: UN snapback dispute and sanctions enforcement
threads.summary: The UN Security Council failed to renew the Iran sanctions Panel of Experts mandate amid the snapback dispute, with the UK issuing an explanation of vote expressing deep regret. The US State Department announced Operation Economic Outcast targeting two entities and three individuals in an Iran-linked crypto network tied to Babak Zanjani, while Treasury offered whistleblowers up to 30% of penalties and the House passed the Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker strike and maritime front
threads.summary: The IRGC said it struck a Togo-flagged tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with IRIB citing UK Maritime Operations reporting a vessel hit by an unidentified projectile. CENTCOM said it has redirected 104 commercial vessels enforcing a US blockade against Iran, and the US is investigating whether Iran was behind August cyberattacks on two energy tankers near Gibraltar.

threads.label: Parchin Taleghan 2 reconstruction reports
threads.summary: Satellite imagery analysed by the Institute for Science and International Security shows Iran rapidly rebuilding the Taleghan 2 facility at the Parchin military complex, previously linked to the AMAD nuclear weapons programme. Israel struck the site in 2024 and March 2026 during Operation Roaring Lion, according to the Jerusalem Post and Iran International.

threads.label: Houthi front and Saudi-Yemen diplomacy
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Saudi Arabia conveyed a proposal via Oman for a two-week Houthi ceasefire and direct talks, while China privately asked Tehran to help rein in the group. A Conflict Armament Research report said Iranian support and foreign technology sustain the Houthis' missile, drone and maritime arsenal.

threads.label: Iran domestic mobilisation and dissent
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran heavy coverage of a claimed 313,000-strong 'devotees' exercise in Greater Tehran attended by the president and Basij commander, with drone displays and messaging from Khamenei on identifying 'the real enemy'. Iran International reported hardliner talk of ousting President Pezeshkian, an Amnesty International 1,000-page report naming 87 officials over the 2022 crackdown, and video of police abusing a teenager drawing public fury.
